Name: Cursor Coords
Author: bruhthisdude25
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Adds coordinates and the map name to appear as an overlay next to your cursor to use the coordinates for mod making and NPC scheduling.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
Extract into the mods folder.

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Coordinates and map names for the coordinates.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Smapi[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Content Patcher[/color][/size]

Manifest.Name: Cursor Coords
Manifest.Description: Displays the X and Y coordinates of the tile currently under the cursor.
Manifest.Author: bruhthisdude25
